'''Vladlun Travan's Hideout''' was a bunker located in the [[Madyn Plains]] region of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The hideout was controlled by [[Vladlun Travan]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] fellow band of [[Vladlun's gang|cronies]].<ref name="SWG:V" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'm going to throw three bounties your way. I've already done the hard part and tracked them to this bunker. See if you can handle the rest.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Boba Fett Throws You To the Wolves|Rori}}</ref>}}
[[File:VladlunTravansHideout.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aerial view of the hideout.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Narmle Militia]] was able to confirm the presence of Vladlun Travan in the bunker and gave this information to [[Wernell Covington]] whose daughter [[Felicia]] had been murdered by Travan years ago. Covington sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the hideout and the latter killed Vladlun Travan to avenge the murder of Covington's daughter.<ref name="SWG:V" /> In the bunker, the spacer also encountered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] who was tracking three associates of Travan: [[Titus Dabrini]], [[Aztin Maru]] and [[Tiaba Charr]]. Fett decided to let the spacer eliminate Travan and his fellow supporters.<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vladlun Travan's Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG:V" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vladlun Travan's Hideout was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
